notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi chrome fetch, no WAF, exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass recorded. Shopify store. TREE: taken from the site's own desktop mega-menu embedded in the homepage HTML (data-menu-handle="furniture", 10 top nodes, 4 of them with depth-1 children), plus the Garden mega-menu (data-menu-handle="garden") which holds the only outdoor furniture node. /collections.json (335 collections) was swept with a furniture keyword regex to catch nodes absent from the nav: only 'corner-sofas' and 'garden-chairs-1' turned up and both are empty (0 products) and unlinked from the menu, so they were dropped. COUNTS: the prior pass's warning that Shopify products_count is wildly inflated on this store was confirmed and avoided - no products_count value was used. Every qty comes from four mutually-agreeing reads on the collection page itself: the rendered header "You're viewing 1-N of N products", the filter-bar "N Results", the theme attribute data-collection-products-count, and exhaustive paging of /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 counting unique product IDs. All four agreed on every leaf. SANITY: counts differ per category (2, 3, 7, 10, 13...) so no site-wide constant; every page's <h1> matched the requested node; a second fresh cache-bypassing read of all 11 non-empty leaves returned identical numbers, so no intra-session drift. HIERARCHY: 'Bar Stools & Dining Chairs' (10), 'Sofas & Armchairs' (0), 'Bedroom Furniture' (11) and 'Tables' (17) all have children in the mega-menu, so they are grouping rows per the URL-hierarchy rule and their parent totals are NOT recorded. Note the parent 'Bar Stools & Dining Chairs' holds 10 while its two children hold 2+7=9 - the extra item is a 'Wicker Swivel Desk Chair' that sits in no child node; likewise 'Tables' (17) vs children summing to 18 with one product double-tagged. ZERO ROWS: 10 leaves are genuinely empty right now - the site renders 'No products found' with data-collection-item-count="0" and products.json returns []. Rockett St George has evidently wound down its upholstery and large case-goods lines. These are real live nav nodes so they are emitted with qty 0 and flagged rather than silently dropped. EXCLUDED: 'View All Furniture' (/collections/furniture, 46), 'Furniture SALE', 'NEW Furniture' and the 'Love Your Curves' collection - navigation/marketing junk per rule 3. 'Shelving & Storage' (24) is filed under the Furniture menu but a tile scan of all 24 products shows they are decorative WALL shelves (Alcove Wall Shelf, Scalloped Wooden Wall Shelf, Angel Wings Wall Shelf, floating shelves) and WALL HOOKS (hand hooks, coat hooks, Milagro heart hook) plus one set of storage boxes - wall shelving belongs to Wall Decor and hooks/boxes are out of scope, so it is dropped. 'Fireplaces & Fire Guards' (1, a 'Beautiful Bird Fire Guard') is a hearth accessory, not furniture. 'Ready To Deliver Sofas' is an availability facet and is empty anyway. 'Home Office' (12), 'Shop By Room: Living Room' (86), 'Bedroom' (92) and 'Dining Room' (24) are mixed marketing room roll-ups - the Home Office tile scan is bookends, tissue boxes, coasters, ornaments and a wall clock with a single desk chair already counted under Bar Stools & Dining Chairs. 'Utility & Storage' (99) and 'Bathroom' (44) were checked and hold no furniture-typed goods (storage baskets/boxes, bath textiles, bathroom hardware) - standalone storage is out of scope here.
